secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (sk_live_…/sk_test_…) from Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys — used to open Checkout sessions for the $5/employee monthly bill.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_…) for the endpoint /api/billing/webhook (checkout.session.completed) — verifies received payments.
